SideMenu

A navigation rail with groups, links and an optional footer.

Copy page as

Props#

PropTypeDefaultDescription
variant"rail" | "drawer""rail"How the menu is presented.
collapsiblebooleanfalseGroups become disclosure widgets.
density"normal" | "compact""normal"Vertical rhythm of the items.

Slots#

$Title
Heading above the groups.
$Group
Keyed. One per section of links.
$Item
A link. Marked current when its href is the page's pathname.
$Footer
Optional. Rendered below the groups.

Example#

Reactogenic compiles the shell of every page once. The layout components run in the compiler and leave plain HTML behind, so paragraph 1 of this page costs exactly its own bytes and nothing else.

<SideMenu density="compact">
  <$Title>Documentation</$Title>
</SideMenu>

Tip

Leave $Footer empty and its rules are not shipped.

Accessibility notes

The current link carries aria-current="page".
